cancellation_note: Full refund for bookings cancelled within 24 hours of booking (applies to bookings at least 3 weeks out). Rescheduling allowed with a fee.
description:
## Your creative hub — from artists to artists

5000 sq ft studio with **16 ready-to-shoot sets**, plus a 10,000 sq ft rooftop (booked separately).

### The sets
Classroom, Full Metal Jacket Room, All White Cyc (add-on), Graffiti Tunnel, Diner Room, Jeffery Manor Tunnel, Light Tunnel, Trap House Set, LED Cube, Pink/Blue Lounge, Cloud Dancer Set, Orange Tunnel, Electric Chair Tunnel, Spaceship Set.

### Good to know
- Your booking time is your setup **and** cleanup time — please be out by the end to avoid overtime (1.5x rate).
- We control what's inside the studio. Bathrooms are shared with the building.
- The rooftop above the space is a separate listing.
- Parking: $10 all-day lot at 1023 S Los Angeles St + metered street parking on Main, Olympic, 11th & Los Angeles St.
- Arrive a little early — finding the door takes a minute the first time.

title: Set Hub Collective

accordions.title: Parking
accordions.body: The parking lot is at 1023 S Los Angeles St, Los Angeles ($10 all day). Metered street parking on Main, Olympic, 11th and Los Angeles St. Arrive a little early — finding our door takes a minute the first time.

accordions.title: Lighting
accordions.body: House lighting included. Pro lighting packages available as add-ons — mention your needs when booking.

accordions.title: Sound
accordions.body: Speakers available in the space. No noise complaints here — feel free.

accordions.title: Space access
accordions.body: Open 24/7. Freight elevator on site — keep all doors closed for it to move. Wheelchair accessible; let the host know in advance so we can help.

accordions.title: Electrical
accordions.body: Standard power throughout the studio. Tell us about heavy power needs when booking.

accordions.title: Host rules
accordions.body: No smoking. No alcohol. Your booking time includes setup and cleanup — overtime is billed at 1.5x the rate. Altering or damaging sets: $150.
